title: The key formula identifying a difference of divisors weighted by orders with the divisor of the tame symbol
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The key formula equates two cycles on X: one built from orders of the local sections f_i and g_i multiplied by the divisors of the trivialising sections of two invertible sheaves, the other from the divisors of the tame symbols partial_{B_i}(f_i, g_i) (statement lines 4745-4758, tag 0AYC). The proof establishes invariance of the identity under rescaling the local trivialising sections, which mixes well-definedness of divisors with the bilinearity and normalisation property of the tame symbol, and then reduces to comparing a single coefficient by localising at a two-dimensional Noetherian local domain and choosing trivialisations so that the first expression collapses. The reduction is the substance of the argument, so the claim is H2.
